purpose: Quantify the frozen GE08 late-time standard-sector deviation from an effective pressureless fluid when the effective dust is matched to the full standard-sector density and momentum, and distinguish this from the inferior baryon-only approximation.

definitions.standard_sector: CLASS total scalar stress minus frozen AeST effective-dark scalar stress
definitions.matched_effective_dust: retain exact standard_delta_rho and standard_momentum; set standard_delta_p=0 and standard_shear=0
definitions.baryon_only: use baryon_delta_rho and baryon momentum rho_b*theta_b

outputs: global and pointwise matched-dust pressure/shear omission ratios
non-baryon residual density and momentum amplitudes
pressure/shear relative to the non-baryon residual density
claim_boundary: GE16 is diagnostic only. PASS does not license the effective-dust approximation or Z20. A later model-choice lock must set its truncation budget independently and explicitly.
anti_tuning: Do not convert observed GE16 residual amplitudes into a retrospective preregistration threshold inside GE16.
